meta.name: add-wechat
meta.description: Add WeChat (personal) channel integration via Tencent's official iLink Bot API. Uses long-polling and QR scan — no webhook, no ToS risk, no paid token.

copy.tagline: 将个人微信接入你的应用,扫码即可收发消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发应用并想给项目加上个人微信消息收发能力。
copy.tagline_en: Connect your app to personal WeChat via official API for messaging
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app that needs personal WeChat messaging.

howto.what: 给 NanoClaw 加上个人微信渠道:通过腾讯官方 iLink Bot API 拉取消息,扫码登录,无需 webhook、无需付费 token。装好后还要把一个微信会话接到 agent 分组,它才能回复。
howto.when: 当你要求把个人微信接入 NanoClaw 时触发。前提是有一个个人微信号、一部能扫码的手机,以及 Node.js >= 20。

say.text: 帮我把个人微信接入 NanoClaw
say.note: 它会拉取微信适配器代码并安装依赖

say.text: 微信二维码链接在哪?发给我扫
把这个微信联系人接到我的 agent 上
say.note: 运行 wire-dm 脚本,选择要接的 agent 分组

howto.what_en: Adds a personal WeChat channel to NanoClaw via Tencent's official iLink Bot API: long-poll for messages, QR scan to log in, no webhook, no paid token. After setup you still wire one WeChat chat to an agent group before it can reply.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add personal WeChat to NanoClaw. Needs a personal WeChat account, a phone to scan the QR code, and Node.js >= 20.

say_en.text: Add my personal WeChat to NanoClaw
say_en.note: It fetches the WeChat adapter and installs the dependency

say_en.text: Send me the WeChat QR link to scan
say_en.note: QR prints to logs and saves to data/wechat/qr.txt

say_en.text: Wire this WeChat contact to my agent
say_en.note: Runs the wire-dm script and asks which agent group
